3. **Sneaker Consignment Portal** ([sell.html](file:///C:/Users/Danyal%20Mehdi/Documents/fast/iict/project/html/sell.html)) — A consignment intake form (brand, model, US size, condition, box condition, optional SKU, asking price) with a live payout calculator (9.5% marketplace fee + $5.00 authentication/insurance fee), drag-and-drop/file-picker image upload with previews, and a confirmation view generating a random `#CSG-xxxxxx` reference code.

- **CSS3**: Flexbox and CSS Grid layouts (e.g., `.sell-form-grid`), transitions, gradients, pseudo-elements (`::before`), CSS custom properties (`--bg-card`, `--border-subtle`, `--neon-orange`, `--font-mono`, `--font-display`, `--accent-red`, etc.), plus an embedded `<style>` block in [signup.html](file:///C:/Users/Danyal%20Mehdi/Documents/fast/iict/project/html/signup.html#L10-L23) and inline `style` attributes across the HTML files.

- **Nested interactive controls (Accessibility):** In [sell.html](file:///C:/Users/Danyal%20Mehdi/Documents/fast/iict/project/html/sell.html#L248-L249), `<input type="file" id="sneaker-file-input" class="sr-only">` is placed *inside* `<div id="upload-dropzone" role="button" tabindex="0">`. Because both elements are focusable/interactive, keyboard users tab into the dropzone and then immediately into the visually hidden file input, which accessibility tools flag as nested interactive controls. Moving `<input type="file">` outside `#upload-dropzone` (or adding `tabindex="-1"`) resolves this while keeping both click and label behavior intact.
- **Unguarded `JSON.parse` on `localStorage`:** In [sell.js](file:///C:/Users/Danyal%20Mehdi/Documents/fast/iict/project/js/sell.js#L222), `JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('stride_consignments') || '[]')` is not wrapped in `try/catch`; if malformed data exists under that key, form submission will throw.
- **Live payout on sub-minimum prices:** In [sell.js](file:///C:/Users/Danyal%20Mehdi/Documents/fast/iict/project/js/sell.js#L43-L50), entering a positive price below the `$50` minimum (e.g., `10`) calculates a live breakdown while typing and only blocks on submit. That is reasonable, though showing a subtle note or `Min $50` hint in the payout box could make it clearer.

#### 2. Login Page ([login.html](file:///C:/Users/Danyal%20Mehdi/Documents/fast/iict/project/html/login.html), [login.css](file:///C:/Users/Danyal%20Mehdi/Documents/fast/iict/project/css/login.css), [login.js](file:///C:/Users/Danyal%20Mehdi/Documents/fast/iict/project/js/login.js))

- **Header Sign Out vs. Form Reset:** Clicking **Sign out** in the Vault panel calls `form.reset()`, whereas clicking **Sign out** in the top header pill triggers `stride:authchange` ([login.js](file:///C:/Users/Danyal%20Mehdi/Documents/fast/iict/project/js/login.js#L151)) and re-renders the form without clearing previously typed credentials.
- **Unguarded `JSON.parse`:** [login.js](file:///C:/Users/Danyal%20Mehdi/Documents/fast/iict/project/js/login.js#L87) parses `stride_accounts` without a `try/catch` fallback.
- **Peer page link in Vault panel:** The *View Order History* button in `#login-success-view` points to `orders.html`, which does not exist yet until your teammate builds it.
